description: Add the central Bedrock model factory make_model() to app/agent_utils.py and refactor the existing helpers to route through it. This is the foundation every call-site migration (FEAT-002) and the test suite (FEAT-004) depend on, so it must land first. Independent of the deploy/infra feature (FEAT-003).
steps: In app/agent_utils.py add make_model(purpose: str = 'generation', model_id: str | None = None, **overrides) -> BedrockModel. Always set region_name from os.environ.get('AWS_REGION') or 'ap-southeast-1'. Resolve the model id with precedence: explicit model_id arg > session_state (cfg_MODEL_ID when purpose=='generation', cfg_JUDGE_MODEL_ID when purpose=='judge') > default 'global.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5'. Validate the resolved id against _VALID_MODEL_IDS; if not in the allow-list, fall back to the default (for judge, fall back to _DEFAULT_JUDGE_MODEL_ID). NEVER put 'temperature' in the kwargs. Honor max_tokens from session_state cfg_max_tokens (default 2048) unless overridden. Merge **overrides last (so callers can pass max_tokens, cache_tools, etc.) and forward all kwargs to BedrockModel.
Refactor get_model() to return make_model('generation') (keep the function name/signature so existing imports keep working). Keep create_agent() working (it can keep calling get_model()).
Keep _get_judge_model_id() as-is but make it the resolver make_model uses for purpose=='judge' (either call it internally or replicate its validated precedence). Do not change its public behavior.
Ensure make_model is importable at module scope (plain def, no leading underscore) so pages, agentcore_utils, and tests can import it.
acceptance_criteria: `cd app && python3 -c "import agent_utils as a; m=a.make_model('generation', model_id='bogus-id'); print(type(m).__name__)"` prints BedrockModel and does not raise (allow-list fallback works, construction is offline).
`cd app && python3 -c "import agent_utils as a; import inspect; print('make_model' in dir(a) and callable(a.make_model) and callable(a.get_model))"` prints True.
make_model never includes a 'temperature' key in the kwargs passed to BedrockModel.
get_model() and create_agent() still exist and are callable; _get_judge_model_id() still returns a value in _VALID_MODEL_IDS.
verification: cd app && python3 -c "import agent_utils as a; m=a.make_model('generation', model_id='bogus-id'); assert type(m).__name__=='BedrockModel'; j=a._get_judge_model_id(); assert j in a._VALID_MODEL_IDS; print('ok')"
findings:
Landed in app/agent_utils.py. Signature: make_model(purpose: str = 'generation', model_id: str | None = None, **overrides) -> BedrockModel. Importable at module scope (plain def).

Resolution precedence for the model id: explicit model_id arg (stripped, if truthy) > session_state (generation -> _get_model_id() which reads cfg_MODEL_ID; judge -> _get_judge_model_id() which reads cfg_JUDGE_MODEL_ID) > default. Default is 'global.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5' for generation and _DEFAULT_JUDGE_MODEL_ID (same value) for judge. After resolution the id is validated against _VALID_MODEL_IDS; if not in the allow-list it falls back to the purpose-specific default. NOTE: explicit model_id is also validated through the allow-list, so a bogus explicit id falls back to the default (relied on by the acceptance test with 'bogus-id').

kwargs built: model_id=resolved, region_name=os.environ.get('AWS_REGION') or 'ap-southeast-1', max_tokens=_get_max_tokens() (session_state cfg_max_tokens, default 2048). **overrides merged LAST so callers can override max_tokens or add cache_tools etc. temperature is hard-removed via kwargs.pop('temperature', None) and never set — claude-haiku-5.x rejects it.

Added helper _get_max_tokens(default=2048). get_model() now just returns make_model('generation'). create_agent() unchanged (still calls get_model()). _get_judge_model_id() unchanged in public behavior and is used as the judge resolver inside make_model. MODEL_ID, _get_model_id, _VALID_MODEL_IDS, _DEFAULT_JUDGE_MODEL_ID all still present and importable.

For FEAT-002 call-site migration: judge sites -> make_model('judge'); generation sites -> make_model('generation'); sites with explicit model id (e.g. M5 economy nova-micro) -> make_model('generation', model_id='apac.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0', max_tokens=1024); sites with explicit max_tokens (e.g. M4 judge max_tokens=1024) -> make_model('judge', max_tokens=1024). Note explicit model_id must be in _VALID_MODEL_IDS or it silently falls back to default.

Verification run offline and passed: py_compile exits 0; make_model('generation', model_id='bogus-id') returns a BedrockModel; _get_judge_model_id() returns a value in _VALID_MODEL_IDS; make_model/get_model callable. No commit made — changes left in the working tree.
